title: የቀጠሮ ማስታወሻ / Appointment Reminder
key_sentences: እባክዎ በቀጠሮዎ ቀን ይህንን ካርድ ይዘው ይምጡ።
ከቀጠሮዎ ሰዓት 15 ደቂቃ ቀደም ብለው ይድረሱ።
Please bring this card with you on the day of your appointment.
Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time.
If you cannot come, please call us in advance.
Bring all the medicines you are currently taking.
